SAY: Your late calls and thermostat range work for me; I cook a few times a week, prefer equal utilities and shared basics, so what's your preference on utilities, groceries, deposit?

<<MOD:FINANCIAL>>
PFR:[cook:A few times a week, no strong kitchen preference, temp:Moderate (68-72°F), usp:Split equally, groc:Split basics (condiments, cleaning), dep:Up to 1 month's rent, pay:Shared app like Splitwise]
FLX:[cook:Happy to cook together sometimes and share kitchen time|if we keep a simple schedule so we don't crowd each other at dinner]
